seo.title: Mike Carroll Roofing – Roofers in Buckinghamshire
seo.description: Family run roofing business in Stoke Mandeville. Roofs, fascias, soffits, guttering and flat roofs across Buckinghamshire.

hero.lead: A family run roofing business in Stoke Mandeville, looking after roofs, fascias, soffits and guttering across Buckinghamshire for over thirty years.

heading: From one tile
to a whole roof.
services.intro: Repairs, replacements and roofline work, done by a family team that has been at it for over thirty years.

items.title: Roof repairs & replacement
items.text: Slipped or cracked tiles fixed, or a full new roof when it’s time.
items.image_alt: Tiled roof against a blue sky

items.title: Fascias, soffits & guttering
items.text: Replacement roofline that looks smart and keeps water away.

items.text: Lead flashing, Velux windows and roof lights.

heading: What customers

reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Recently had a house porch rebuilt and the flat roof on a small extension replaced. Mike provided a detailed quote with options depending on what they found as the work progressed.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Mike's team replaced my facias, soffits and guttering, they arrived on time and did a great job, it all looks brilliant, they cleaned up before they left…
items.label: Which? review

items.text: We have two large roofs, old buildings with old tiles. Gales and tree bough impact had left us with cracked and slipped tiles. Mike's team did a super job.
items.label: Which? review

quote.intro: Three quick steps and we’ll get back to you.

faqs.a: Yes. Mike Carroll Roofing is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.
We work across Buckinghamshire, including Aylesbury, Amersham, Beaconsfield, Buckingham, High Wycombe, Hemel Hempstead, Leighton Buzzard and Milton Keynes.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 01296 612699. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
